description: Set or change the company tracking domain: one hostname every sending domain uses for tracked links and opens, for example links.example.com. Any subdomain the user controls works; a bare root domain is rejected. Publish the returned trackingDomain.cnameRecord. It never blocks sending: until it verifies, links use the shared Sequenzy domain. Changing it keeps the previous hostname serving links in emails already sent while its old CNAME stays. Confirm the hostname with the user first.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

domain.description: Tracking hostname, a subdomain such as links.example.com.

name: set_tracking_domain

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `set_tracking_domain` MCP tool.

trackingDomain.description: Company tracking domain {domain, status, active, everVerified, sslStatus, verifiedAt, lastCheckedAt, error, cnameRecord}. Publish cnameRecord; active is true once it verifies and links use it.
